summary: All three requirements are substantially implemented. REQ-29 (FeedPage), REQ-30 (Header Feed link), and REQ-31 (App.tsx route) are all present. However, REQ-29 requires displaying the uploader's principal (truncated) on each card, but the FeedPage.tsx implementation shows only the PDF title, filename, and date — no uploader principal is visible in the card content.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each entry should show the uploader's principal (truncated for readability) on the card.
missing_requirements.reason: The FeedPage.tsx FeedCard component renders the PDF title, filename, and upload date/time, but there is no field displaying the uploader's principal. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires each card to display the uploader principal (truncated).
